title: Keeping invited players on the same team

abstract.text: Return a Boolean value that indicates whether players in the same match requests are on the same team.

paragraphs.text: -`teams`: The teams in the rule set. Pass the `teams` array that’s available in team rule expressions. -`players`: The players that the rule applies to. Pass the `players` array that’s available in team rule expressions.

`true` if the players in the same match requests are on the same team; otherwise, `false`. The players in a match request include the local player and any recipients or other players that the local player invites.
